There is a right-angle mark at W, and the figure shows that WX and XY at X also form a right angle. Then reason: In triangle WZX, ∠ZWX = 90°, the problem gives m∠ZXW = x - 11 and m∠WZX = x - 9. Therefore (x - 11) + (x - 9) + 90 = 180, giving x = 55. Thus m∠ZXW = 55 - 11 = 44°. At point X, ∠WXY is 90°, and diagonal XZ divides this right angle into ∠ZXW and ∠ZXY, so m∠ZXY = 90° - 44° = 46°.

method.method_draft: Read the image as having vertical sides WZ and XY parallel, with diagonal ZX acting as a transversal. The target ∠ZXY is the angle between ZX and the right vertical side XY, while ∠WZX is the corresponding/alternate interior angle between ZX and the left vertical side WZ, so m∠ZXY = m∠WZX. To determine x, use right triangle WZX: the right-angle marker at W gives ∠ZWX = 90°, and the text gives the other two angles as x - 11 and x - 9. Thus (x - 11) + (x - 9) = 90, giving x = 55. 推理：在三角形 WZX 中，∠ZWX = 90°，题目给出 m∠ZXW = x - 11，m∠WZX = x - 9。三角形内角和为 180°，所以这两个锐角之和为 90°：
(x - 11) + (x - 9) = 90。
化简得 2x - 20 = 90，所以 2x = 110，x = 55。
因此 m∠WZX = x - 9 = 55 - 9 = 46°。
因为 WZ ∥ XY，且 ZX 是截线，所以 ∠WZX 与 ∠ZXY 是相等的内错角。因此 m∠ZXY = 46°。
